best_for: Home and project-studio musicians and podcasters who want a complete audio workstation for a USD 60 license, on Windows, macOS or Linux.

points.title: 60 days, full features
points.text: The evaluation runs 60 days with nothing switched off, so you can finish a real project before you decide.

points.title: USD 60 or USD 225
points.text: The discounted license is USD 60 for personal use, schools, nonprofits, and businesses with up to USD 20,000 in yearly gross revenue. Everyone else pays USD 225 for the commercial license. All sales are final. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: Upgrades through 8.99
points.text: A license bought now covers free updates through version 8.99, so the next major version is included.

points.title: Most plugin formats
points.text: It loads VST, VST3, AU, CLAP, LV2, DX and its own JS effects. CLAP and LV2 work on all three systems.

points.title: Runs on old and small machines
points.text: The installers are small, about 17 MB for Windows x64. Builds cover Windows XP through 11 (x64, 32-bit, and a beta for Arm), macOS 10.5 through 26, and Linux on x86-64, i686, aarch64 and armv7l. It can also run from a portable drive.

points.title: Closed source on every system
points.text: REAPER is proprietary software from Cockos, Linux included. The Flatpak carries Cockos's name, but Flathub does not mark it verified, and it is at 7.85 while Windows and macOS have 7.86.

points.title: Versions kept
points.text: The Windows listing keeps 148 versions, in x86, x64 and Arm64 installers for all users. macOS and Linux list only the current release.
